verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an API inference platform, so publishing a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents one. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. OpenAI-SDK compatibility is a separate feature and does not count as DeepInfra publishing its own machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
